newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-NIGERIAN BABAYARO SET TO SIGN FOR CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIGERIAN BABAYARO SET TO SIGN FOR CHELSEA.

text.p: Anderlecht's Nigerian international Celestine Babayaro is set to sign for English premier league side Chelsea, the Belgian club said on Wednesday.
Anderlecht deputy manager Robert De Pot told Reuters the two clubs had reached an agreement in principle on Babayaro's transfer following negotiations on Tuesday.
He added that the 18-year-old defender, a member of Nigeria's Olympic gold medal winning team, and Chelsea would meet again next week for further talks but declined to give more details.
On Sunday, Chelsea reached next month's English F.A. Cup final with a 3-0 win over Wimbledon.
